title: Reachability in one step
statement: Let $A$ be a machine with memory, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. If $G$ holds at configuration $a$, then the machine reaches the configuration obtained from $a$ by one step, with $G$ holding at every configuration strictly before that endpoint.
